limitations: Only captured messages are evidence; absent events do not establish a product defect or successful UI action.
The forwarding wrapper logs after forwarding; cross-direction log order may differ from transmission order. Requests are paired using actual typed JSON-RPC IDs, not proximity.

Hover carries no document version. observedClientVersion is log context, not server acknowledgement; returned tags/types are matched against reconstructed source snapshots without claiming a unique version when text repeats.
Diagnostics without an explicit integer server version are retained but cannot satisfy the versioned diagnostic control.
The two-field SyncProbe extraction is intentionally bounded to this fixture's raw Go tags; it is not a general Go parser.
Sessions are delimited by identity records. Simultaneously writing independent wrappers to one untagged trace could make session assignment ambiguous.
This script does not observe UI highlight counts, prove live class loading, save files, or modify/repair the transport.
The initial Unicode hover followed auto-save; only Undo-hover and first compiler errors have separate unsaved disk checkpoints
Unicode JSON tag names provoke two actual SA5008 severity-2 warnings; these differ from the later severity-1 compiler errors
Matching hover fields/tags is not a full-source server hash acknowledgement or a uniquely versioned hover response
Native observation of UI counts is independent of analyzer output and is limited to this 2/0/2/0 fixture
Earlier uncaptured struct-helper 3/5 highlight counts remain unknown; this cohort cannot retrospectively explain them
Unit-test DocumentContentSynchronizer sends immediately; this standalone trace separately exercises normal grouped/committed-document scheduling
Full GoLand equivalence, IME behavior, all editor scheduling and deletion/close races remain open
